description.fun: A fickle kitten that loves attention and sulks when it's ignored. Its fluffy fur is much like a plant's, soaking up sunlight for energy, so Sprigatito washes its face often to keep it from drying out. Rubbing its paws together releases a sweet scent that mesmerizes everyone nearby, enough to make foes forget to fight, and the scent grows stronger in the sun.
description.guide: The Grass-type first partner Pokémon of Paldea, from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. Sprigatito's plant-like fur absorbs sunlight and its paws release a soothing scent. It evolves into Floragato and then Meowscarada.
description.tagline: An attention-seeking kitten with a mesmerizing sweet scent

description.fun: Floragato hides a vine inside its long fur with a hard flower bud on the end, which it swings at foes or plays with like a yo-yo. When it's ready to battle, its fur turns needle sharp. Clever and mischievous, it craves attention, and a Trainer who ignores it may wake up tied up in its vine. The scalloped 'boots' on its legs may tip a hat to Puss in Boots.
description.guide: The middle stage of Sprigatito's line. Floragato swings a hard flower bud on a vine hidden in its fur, and its fur stiffens into sharp needles for battle.
description.tagline: A show-off cat that fights with a flower-bud yo-yo

description.fun: A stage magician of a cat. The reflective lining of its cape hides the stem of its flower, so the bloom seems to float in midair, and with skilful misdirection it rigs its foes with pollen-packed flower bombs and sets them off before they notice. Proud and showy, it also gets jealous when its Trainer fusses over other Pokémon. Its masked look draws on masquerade balls and gentleman thieves.
description.guide: The final evolution of Sprigatito and Paldea's Grass-type first partner, a Grass and Dark-type Pokémon themed on stage magicians. It plants flower bombs on opponents by sleight of hand.
description.tagline: A masked magician cat with exploding flower tricks
